FRO Dashboard_new_updated.data_description: This dataset contains information on customer service cases, including timestamps for creation and closure, various time metrics related to case handling, and calculated performance metrics, enabling analysis of ticket management and operational efficiency.

Number of Tickets.formula: IF [last_queue] = 'U4B Business API Triage' OR [initial_queue] = 'U4B Business API Triage' THEN [casenumber] ELSE NULL END

Centralized CommOps L10N Metrics.data_description: The dataset contains over 2 million records related to project performance metrics, including both numerical and categorical data, focusing on cost, savings, and touchless processes across various projects and time periods.

Domain.formula:
if CONTAINS([domain], 'L&D - WF') THEN [domain]
ELSEIF CONTAINS([domain], 'Bliss') THEN 'Bliss Translate'
ELSEIF CONTAINS([domain], 'L&D') OR 
CONTAINS([domain], 'L-D') OR
CONTAINS([domain], 'L_D') THEN 'L&D'
ELSE [domain] END

Touchless Type.formula: if [vendor] = 'MT Only' THEN 'Touchless' ELSE 'Human in Loop' END

Language Tier Strings.formula:
if ISNULL([language_tier]) then 'Unknown'
else 'Tier ' + STR([language_tier]) END

Platform.formula:
if [mt_saving_source] = 'Bliss Translate' THEN 'Off Phrase'
else 'On Phrase' END

Touchless Dimension.formula:
if [Parameters].[Dimension Name (copy)_526639702199148561] = 'Touchless Type' THEN [Touchless Type]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Dimension Name (copy)_526639702199148561] = 'Touchless Source' THEN [client_category]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Dimension Name (copy)_526639702199148561] = 'Touchless Domain' THEN [mt_saving_source]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Dimension Name (copy)_526639702199148561] = 'Target Locale' THEN [Target Locale Refined]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Dimension Name (copy)_526639702199148561] = 'Region' THEN [mega_region]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Dimension Name (copy)_526639702199148561] = 'Platform' THEN [Platform]
END

TWC - Dynamic.formula:
IF ABS(SUM([twc])) >= 1000000000 THEN
//round for billions
STR(ROUND(SUM([twc] / 1000000000), 2)) + "B"
ELSEIF ABS(SUM([twc])) >= 1000000 THEN
//round for millions
STR(ROUND(SUM([twc] / 1000000), 2)) + "M"
ELSEIF ABS(SUM([twc])) >= 1000 THEN
//round for thousands
STR(ROUND(SUM([twc] / 1000), 2)) + "K"
ELSE
STR(ROUND(SUM([twc]),0))
END

CPW.formula: IF SUM([cost])/SUM([twc]) < 0 THEN NULL ELSE SUM([cost])/SUM([twc]) END

TM %.formula: IF [TM % Pre (copy)_126593412764794883] < 0 THEN NULL ELSE [TM % Pre (copy)_126593412764794883] END

Color Code - CPW Std CG Capped.formula:
IF [CPW] > AVG([CPW Avg All (copy)_542683772359884807]) + 2 * AVG([cpw_std_cg])  
THEN 5
ELSEIF [CPW] > AVG([CPW Avg All (copy)_542683772359884807]) + 1 * AVG([cpw_std_cg])
THEN 4
ELSEIF [CPW] > AVG([CPW Avg All (copy)_542683772359884807]) - 1 * AVG([cpw_std_cg]) or ISNULL([CPW])
THEN 3
ELSEIF [CPW] > AVG([CPW Avg All (copy)_542683772359884807]) - 2 * AVG([cpw_std_cg])
THEN 2
ELSE 1 END

TM % Pre V2.formula:
(
sum(if [vendor] = 'MT Only' then 0 ELSE [twc]  end) - 
sum(if [vendor] = 'MT Only' then 0 ELSEIF [wwc] > [twc] then [twc] ELSE [wwc] end)
)/
sum(if [vendor] = 'MT Only' then 0 ELSE [twc]  end)

Color Code - CPW Std All Capped.formula:
IF [CPW] > AVG([CPW Avg All]) + 2 * AVG([cpw_std_all])
THEN 5
ELSEIF [CPW] > AVG([CPW Avg All]) + 1 * AVG([cpw_std_all])
THEN 4
ELSEIF [CPW] > AVG([CPW Avg All]) - 1 * AVG([cpw_std_all]) OR ISNULL([CPW])
THEN 3
ELSEIF [CPW] > AVG([CPW Avg All]) - 2 * AVG([cpw_std_all])
THEN 2
ELSE 1 END

Spend - Dynamic.formula:
IF ABS(SUM([cost])) >= 1000000000 THEN
//round for billions
"$" + STR(ROUND(SUM([cost] / 1000000000), 2)) + "B"
ELSEIF ABS(SUM([cost])) >= 1000000 THEN
//round for millions
"$" + STR(ROUND(SUM([cost] / 1000000), 2)) + "M"
ELSEIF ABS(SUM([cost])) >= 1000 THEN
//round for thousands
"$" + STR(ROUND(SUM([cost] / 1000), 2)) + "K"
ELSE
"$" + STR(ROUND(SUM([cost]),0))
END

Resource Type.formula:
IF vendor in ('Acolad', 'Translated', 'Welocalize') THEN 'LSP'
else vendor end

Dimension.formula:
if [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Resource Type' THEN [Resource Type]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Resource Name' THEN [vendor]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Line of Business' THEN [client_category]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Client' THEN [client]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Domain' THEN [Domain]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Source Locale Type' THEN [source_locale_type]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Source Locale' THEN [source_locale]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Target Locale' THEN [Target Locale Refined]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Target Language Tier' THEN [Language Tier Strings]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 7] = 'Region' THEN [mega_region]
END

Metric.formula:
if [Parameters].[Parameter 6] = 'TWC' THEN SUM([twc])
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 6] = 'Spend' THEN SUM([cost])
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 6] = 'CPW' THEN [CPW]
END

Metric Label.formula:
if [Parameters].[Parameter 6] = 'CPW' THEN STR(ROUND([CPW],2))
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 6] = 'Spend' THEN [Spend (copy)_4627659770320306176]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Parameter 6] = 'TWC' THEN [TWC (copy)_4627659770321125377]
END

TaT Caculated.formula: SUM([TaT_sum (Custom SQL Query1)]) / SUM([job_count (Custom SQL Query1)])

TaT Breakdown.formula:

ELSEIF [Parameters].[Compare By (copy)_807059183526182912] = 'LOB' THEN [client_category (Custom SQL Query1)]
ELSEIF [Parameters].[Compare By (copy)_807059183526182912] = 'Client' THEN [client (Custom SQL Query1)]

Color code - Combined - All - Threshold.formula:
CASE [Parameters].[Parameter 1]
WHEN 1 THEN 

CASE [Color code - All (copy)_313844613151555584]
WHEN 1 THEN "50% + Below SLA"
WHEN 2 THEN "25% - 50% Below SLA"
WHEN 3 THEN "0% - 25% Below SLA"
WHEN 4 THEN "0% - 50% + Above SLA"
WHEN 5 THEN "50% + Above SLA"
END 

WHEN 2 THEN
CASE [color code - Client Category New (copy)_563301807292854283] 
WHEN 1 THEN "[Avg + 2 STDDEV, ∞]"
WHEN 2 THEN "[Avg + 1 STDDEV, Avg + 2 STDDEV]"
WHEN 3 THEN "[Avg - STDDEV, Avg + STDDEV]"
WHEN 4 THEN "[Avg- 2 STDDEV, Avg - STDDEV]"
WHEN 5 THEN "[-∞, Avg - 2 STDDEV]]"
END

END

"Comparing to AVG and STDDEV"
+"

"
+"STDDEV: " + LEFT(STR(ROUND([F - All Std (copy)_3113676202876919816],2)), 4)

+" 
"
+"Lime: " + LEFT(STR(ROUND([F - All Avg - Calculated (copy)_3113676202876825607]- 2 * [F - All Std (copy)_3113676202876919816],2)), 4) + ' < value <= ' + LEFT(STR(ROUND([F - All Avg - Calculated (copy)_3113676202876825607] - 1*[F - All Std (copy)_3113676202876919816],2)), 4)
+" 
"
+"Pine: Value <=" + LEFT(STR(ROUND([F - All Avg - Calculated (copy)_3113676202876825607] - 2 * [F - All Std (copy)_3113676202876919816],2)), 4)
